from.place: Proof, paragraph beginning "For an admissible exceptional adjoint", sentence "the projection transformation of [def-exchange-projection] is a composite of precisely these tensor and counit maps, hence is equivariant as well": the Frobenius-transported compactification differs from the chosen one, so the two projection composites must be compared through the refinement comparison.

title: Projection transformations of two compactifications agree under the refinement comparison
statement: Use the finite-field, coefficient, scheme and operation conventions of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], with $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$, $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $c_1=(j_1,p_1)$, $c_2=(j_2,p_2)$ be two compactifications of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], so $j_i:X\hookrightarrow\overline X_i$ is an open immersion, $p_i:\overline X_i\to Y$ is proper and $p_ij_i=f$. Write $Rf_!^{c_i}=Rp_{i*}j_{i!}$ and $$\rho_{c_1,c_2}:Rf_!^{c_1}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf_!^{c_2}$$ for the compactification comparison: at $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$ the natural isomorphism of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] (through a common refinement), on complexes with étale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]; at $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ its completed, rationalized and common-stage forms, on the coefficient domains on which [fix-lem-exchanges] (4) uses them. Let $\operatorname{PF}^{c_i}_{f,K,L}:Rf_!^{c_i}K\otimes^L_\Lambda L\to Rf_!^{c_i}(K\otimes^L_\Lambda Lf^*L)$ be the projection transformations of [def-exchange-projection] for the compactifications $c_i$ (completed tensor and pullback at $\mathcal O_E$). Then for every $K\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] in these domains $$\rho_{c_1,c_2}(K\otimes^L_\Lambda Lf^*L)\circ\operatorname{PF}^{c_1}_{f,K,L}=\operatorname{PF}^{c_2}_{f,K,L}\circ\bigl(\rho_{c_1,c_2}(K)\otimes 1_L\bigr).$$ No invertibility of $\operatorname{PF}^{c_i}$ is asserted.
